question: Motion to Waive All Applicable Budgetary Discipline Re: Ossoff Amdt. No. 4897
bill_title: A concurrent resolution setting forth the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2026 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2027 through 2035.
plain_language: This vote was on waiving budget rules so an amendment to S.Con.Res. 33 could be considered. The sponsor's official statement of purpose for the amendment: “To create a point of order against reconciliation legislation fails to address the practice of insurance companies stepping between patients and their doctors to delay or deny access to care.” Waiving needs 60 votes (three-fifths). A Yea supports the waiver; a Nay keeps the budget point of order in place, which blocks the amendment.
